name: outreach-scope-wiring
title: 把 xhs:outreach 挂进 capability 的 auth_scope（票 5av）
description: B 类裁定：挂。收紧 xhs:outreach 语义为机制∧策略，声明进 comment_reply/dm_send 的 auth_scope，并让 engagement 发送经 Gateway 携带 granted_scopes 真正被检查。
creator: codex
notes: DONE 2026-10-31 (B-class ruling: wire it). Semantics were tightened first, then the declaration follows the check. (1) XhsCredential.scopes grants xhs:outreach on outreach.allows_engagement (mode != nobody), not allows_proactive; module/constant/property docstrings state the rule: a scope can only say "this account's policy allows it to engage"; cold-start target/budget stays a service-layer question (check_dm_target_allowed + EngagementApproval). nobody loses the tier but xhs:write for publishing stays. (2) xhs.comment_reply / xhs.dm_send now declare auth_scope=("xhs:write", "xhs:outreach") in backend/tools/runtime/catalog.py. (3) The real enforcement point: XHSEngagement.reply_to_comment / send_dm resolve granted_scopes(account_id) (injectable seam), judge BEFORE the Effect claim (missing scope -> blocked/permission_denied, no intent row, no browser), then shared_gateway().invoke(capability, payload, thread_id, granted_scopes) executes the send; ToolResult maps back to the module's verdict vocabulary (timeout/transport failure -> unknown, never failed). Browser step stays on the caller instance via the _DISPATCH_TRANSPORT ContextVar; the capability implementation (tools/xhs/engagement.py) marks inside_capability=True so it does not nest the Gateway (nested invoke would wait on its own max_concurrency=1 slot). (4) Tests: new test_xhs_engagement_gateway.py (declared-scope satisfiability, refusal with missing write/tier, capability+thread_id+grant assertions, pre-claim refusal leaves no ledger row, timeout->unknown, direct path does not nest); test_scope_coverage register updated (7 scoped capabilities, 8 checked call sites, unscoped-debt = 0); pre-decision boundary assertions updated and named. (5) Docs: tool-gateway doc new section 3.1.1 with semantics/grant/declaration/call-site/ordering/coverage/honest boundary; §9.5-② landed; tool-runtime capability table cells regenerated scope column; publish-action scope row synced by Lead. Known caveat recorded in doc: direct capability callers that pass no granted_scopes keep the §7.1 opt-in semantics; this slice makes the service send path mandatory, not the Gateway global default.
